text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm posting the release-note draft for tomorrow's 09:00 UTC change window. TL;DR: runtime perf tweaks, canary routing for small customers, and a fix for Dedicated capacity autoscale. Need pin matrix + one last QA approval.

aj: Got it. Pushed a first-pass copy to the internal RN doc. Shortening the TL;DR now — want something one-line for the all-hands.

sasha: Can you paste the TL;DR here? I'll make a microcopy suggestion and check legal wording.

maria: TL;DR candidate: "Improved token throughput and routing resilience; Dedicated autoscale fixes." Too long?

aj: I like it. Suggest: "Better throughput and more resilient routing (Dedicated autoscale fixes)." shorter. :+1:

ops-oncall: Quick ops note — can we confirm rollback threshold and canary percentages? If we hit errors >2% in canary we'll cut traffic. Also need the maintainers list for fast paging.

maria: Proposed canary: 5% initial traffic for 20 minutes, expand to 25% after OK. Rollback if error rate >2% or latency regression >25% P50. Maintainers: aj, rachel, ops-oncall.

aj: Deploybot config I'll use (draft):
```
/deploy schedule --service=r-runtime --image=redwood/runtime:v2.3.1-canary --canary=5% --canary-duration=20m --expand=25% --rollback-on-error=2%
```
Can ops-oncall confirm the command semantics?

ops-oncall: That looks right. Make sure the deploybot team flag is set to "eng-runtime" so oncall routing works. Also include a quiet window 09:00-11:00 UTC for monitoring.

sasha: Legal/marketing wants a one-line about customer impact: "No API surface changes. Performance and reliability improvements only." Can we add that to the RN copy?

maria: Added that sentence. Also added an embargo note: do not publish public blog until M+24 hours unless no regressions.

aj: Quick checklist for RN final:
- final TL;DR (done)
- maintainers (done)
- deploybot command (done)
- pin matrix entry for models touched
- staging smoke: 2024-02-14 02:00 UTC (ops to confirm)

maria: For the pin matrix: we're pinning model v2.3.1 to Dedicated pools A+B, host fallback to v2.2.9 for lower tiers. I put a table in the doc; please review.

ops-oncall: Confirmed staging smoke time OK. I'll schedule a pager rotation: ops-oncall -> aj -> rachel.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled by aj for 2024-02-14T09:00:00Z. Canary at 5% for 20m, expansion to 25% on success. Rollback triggered by error rate >2% or latency P50 increase >25%.

aj: Final ask — can someone eyeball the release-note microcopy for accessibility / shortness? sasha?

sasha: On it. I'll post a trimmed version in 10m and mark the doc as "ready-to-announce" if no objections.

maria: Perfect. If RN is green by EOD I'll pin the internal announce and trigger the deploybot schedule. Thanks team. :rocket:
